让每次唤醒，都有恰到好处的光。: Set just the right glow for every interaction.

让助手看见你想询问的内容。: Show your assistant what you want to ask about.
调整输入设备，获得清晰准确的转写。: Choose your microphone and improve transcription.
连接你信任的 AI 服务。: Connect an AI service you trust.
设置助手如何理解屏幕与图片。: Choose how your assistant interprets screens and images.
选择自然的声音和朗读方式。: Choose a voice and how replies are read aloud.
管理对话记录与数据的保留方式。: Manage saved conversations and retained data.
让小爱同学连接这台电脑，保留原有语音体验。: Connect XiaoAI to this PC while keeping its native assistant.
在你允许的范围内，查看 QQ 通知和接收文件的动态。: Monitor QQ notifications and received files with your permission.
分别管理每段对话，以及由你定义的个人记忆和指令。: Manage separate conversations, personal memory and custom commands.
保存后应用语言；原始提问、历史文本和代码不会被改写。: Apply on save. Your questions, saved text and code remain unchanged.
使用 Qwen3-ASR 核对完整发言，支持普通话、粤语、英语及中英混说。关闭后: Qwen3-ASR checks the complete utterance in Mandarin, Cantonese, English and mixed speech. Turn off to use faster SenseVoice.
当前使用 SenseVoice 复核。安装新版完整安装包后可使用 Qwen3-A: SenseVoice is available. Install the complete package to use Qwen3-ASR.
说一句平时会用的指令，听完后这里会显示最终转写。: Say a typical command. The final transcription will appear here.
试录仅在本机转写。识别出的文字留在此处。: Test audio is transcribed locally. The text stays here.
没有检测到说话声。请检查输入设备和音量后重试。: No speech detected. Check the input device and volume, then try again.
无法完成试录。请检查 Windows 输入设备和麦克风权限。: Could not finish the test. Check the Windows input device and microphone permission.
允许助手自动操作电脑: Allow the assistant to control this PC
在语音或文字对话中提出操作请求后，助手会直接使用当前 Windows 账户执行。: Requested actions run under your Windows account. Command output is sent to your current AI service.
登录 Windows 后保持 Copilot 键可用。: Keep the assistant available after signing in to Windows.
显示系统托盘图标（下次启动）: Show tray icon on next launch
语音键触发时后台加载准确识别模型；说完 30 秒后释放大模型，保留实时识别。使用: The accurate model loads in the background when voice input starts, then unloads after 30 seconds idle. Live recognition stays ready. Active recognition and synthesis finish safely.
应用启动先开新对话；默认在上次交互后 15 分钟内自动续接，超过后新建。也可随时: Start fresh on launch. Continue within 15 minutes of your last interaction, then start a new conversation. You can also start fresh or resume history at any time.
此处由你填写的记忆会随问题发送到当前模型服务；不自动提取历史中的内容。不要填写密: Your saved preferences are sent with requests to your AI service. History is not automatically mined for memories. Do not enter passwords or API keys. Retains up to 300 conversations, 100 turns each; legacy history is kept as one conversation.
完整匹配触发词，忽略大小写、空格与标点。多个说法用 | 分隔。自定义任务仍使用现: Match the entire phrase, ignoring case, spaces and punctuation. Separate alternatives with |. Custom tasks use your existing AI service and PC-control permissions.
普通语音按量账户的现金余额与资源包目前需在官方控制台查询。国际站 Token P: Pay-as-you-go speech balances and packages currently require the official console. The international Token Plan has a separate quota API and subscription key.
MiniMax 国际站订阅 Key · Windows 凭据管理器: MiniMax subscription key · Windows Credential Manager
用“小爱同学，用电脑助手……”进入技能；电脑执行后，把结果交回小爱播报。: Invoke the PC-assistant skill through XiaoAI. The PC returns completed results for XiaoAI to speak.
需要先在小爱开放平台配置技能和 HTTPS 服务。普通原生对话不会被本功能监听或: Configure a skill and HTTPS service first. Native conversations are not monitored or intercepted.
电脑配对密钥 · 仅存 Windows 凭据管理器: PC pairing key · Windows Credential Manager only
电脑主动连接技能服务，不在电脑开放控制端口。执行遵循当前电脑自动操作设置，过程仍: The PC makes outbound connections; no control port is exposed. Tasks follow existing permissions and remain visible. Query long-running results through the skill; background speech is not yet verified.
文件变化和系统通知分别检测，内容只作为数据，不作为自动执行指令。: Monitor file changes and notifications separately. Their content is treated as data, never automatic commands.
不读取加密聊天数据库，不注入 QQ 进程。系统通知不等于完整聊天记录。: No encrypted chat databases are read and no QQ process is injected. Notifications are not full chat history.
允许已配对的小爱读取 QQ 检测结果: Allow paired XiaoAI to read QQ results
只记录启用期间捕获的变化，最多保留 100 条在内存。QQ 未发送到 Windo: Keeps up to 100 events in memory while enabled. Messages not sent to Windows notifications cannot be captured. File monitoring cannot identify the sender or guarantee a complete download.
请按功能键或组合键，例如 Ctrl + Alt + Space。: Use a function key or combination, such as Ctrl + Alt + Space.
默认使用 Copilot 键。保存后，短按开启语音，双击进入静默输入，长按截图。: The Copilot key is the default. Tap for speech, double-tap for silent input, hold for a screenshot.
使用默认按键时，在 Windows 的 Copilot 键设置中选择 Windo: For the default key, choose Windows Intelligence in Windows Copilot-key settings.
MiniMax API Key · Windows 凭据管理器: MiniMax API key · Windows Credential Manager
MiniMax 默认使用 Speech-2.8-HD，失败后自动使用 Speec: MiniMax uses Speech-2.8-HD and falls back to Turbo on failure. Text is sent to MiniMax for synthesis.
ElevenLabs API Key · Windows 凭据管理器: ElevenLabs API key · Windows Credential Manager
选择 ElevenLabs 后，待朗读的文本会发送到 api.elevenlab: When selected, text to speak is sent to api.elevenlabs.io.
在内存中保留最近一张截图用于下一轮: Keep the latest image in memory for follow-ups
开机启动需要已安装的 MSIX 包身份。: Startup requires an installed MSIX package.
请保存至少 32 字符的电脑配对密钥。: Save a pairing key of at least 32 characters.
QQ 下载目录不存在或是目录链接。: The QQ folder is missing or is a directory link.
无法连接服务。: Unable to connect to the service.

可框选裁剪或遮挡敏感区域。: Select a region to crop or redact sensitive areas.

选择执行工具与工作空间。只发送本次任务，不转发整段聊天。: Choose a tool and workspace. Only this task is sent, not the entire conversation.
任务已排队，关闭窗口后仍会继续。可在作业列表查看进度。: Task queued. It continues if you close this window; follow progress in Jobs.
WorkBuddy 云任务不绑定本机目录。: WorkBuddy cloud tasks do not use local directories.
此任务暂无可继续的本机会话。: This task has no local session to continue.
请先等待当前任务完成或取消。: Wait for this task to finish or cancel it first.
尚无作业，选择工具和工作空间后派发。: No jobs yet. Choose a tool and workspace, then dispatch.
Harness 已检测到，任务在所选本机目录执行。: Harness detected. Tasks run in the selected local directory.
未检测到 Harness，请在设置中指定命令路径。: Harness not found. Set its command path in Settings.
使用已登录的 ChatGPT / Codex 本地执行入口，任务在所选目录执行。: Uses your signed-in ChatGPT / Codex local runner in the selected directory.
未检测到 Codex，请先安装或配置命令路径。: Codex not found. Install it or configure its command path.
WorkBuddy 无需本机安装即可使用云端 API，但需单独授权；云沙箱不能直: WorkBuddy Cloud requires separate authorization, not a local installation. Its sandbox cannot directly access local folders.
把任务交给指定工具，在你选择的工作空间执行。: Delegate tasks to a tool in your chosen workspace.
DeepSeek Harness 和 ChatGPT / Codex 使用本机工: Harness and ChatGPT / Codex use local directories. WorkBuddy Cloud uses a remote sandbox; local files are not automatically uploaded.
沿用已安装运行时，不修改桌面共享配置。: Uses the installed runtime without changing your desktop profile.
Harness 复用已配置的官方 DeepSeek 凭据: Use your configured official DeepSeek credential for Harness
凭据只传给本次启动进程，不写入任务内容、日志或 Harness 配置。: The credential is passed only to the child process, not task text, logs or Harness configuration.
使用 Codex 官方本地执行入口和已有登录；不冒充普通网页聊天或云端工作区。: Uses the official local Codex runner and existing sign-in. This is separate from regular web chat or a cloud workspace.
此电脑未安装 WorkBuddy 也能使用其官方云端任务 API。需要开放平台授: WorkBuddy's official cloud task API works without local installation. An authorized Open Platform access token is required; a model API key cannot be used.
WorkBuddy Access Token · Windows 凭据管理器: WorkBuddy access token · Windows Credential Manager
云端接收不等于完成；网络中断不自动重发。关闭作业窗口后本机任务继续，退出整个应用: Cloud acceptance is not completion. Interrupted submissions are not retried automatically. Closing this window keeps local jobs running; exiting the app stops local jobs.
请选择本机的完整工作目录。: Choose an absolute local workspace path.
请填写任务，最多 20000 字。: Enter a task of up to 20,000 characters.

待处理任务已达 20 个，请等待或取消部分任务。: The queue has 20 tasks. Wait or cancel some tasks.
此目标尚未安装或找不到命令，请在设置中检查路径。: This tool is not installed or its command was not found. Check Settings.
无法启动目标工具。: Unable to start the selected tool.
WorkBuddy 云端尚未授权。无需安装客户端，但需要在任务派发设置中保存官方: WorkBuddy Cloud is not authorized. No local client is required; save an official access token in Task dispatch settings.
只能继续作业列表中同一工具、同一工作目录的已结束任务。: Continue a finished job using the same tool and workspace from the job list.
此任务的续聊标识无效，或目标暂不支持续聊。: Invalid continuation ID or this target does not support continuation.
只有已接收的 WorkBuddy 云任务可查询远端状态。: Only accepted WorkBuddy cloud jobs support remote status refresh.
应用已退出，未自动重做此任务。: The app exited. This task was not restarted automatically.
已停止本机执行；不会自动重试。: Local execution stopped. It will not be retried automatically.
无法读取作业历史，原文件已保留。: Unable to read job history. The original file was preserved.
作业历史暂时无法保存，任务仍可在内存中查看。: Unable to save job history. Tasks remain visible in memory.
云端接收不等于完成；网络中断不自动重发。关闭作业窗口后本机任务继续，正常退出整个: A cloud receipt is not completion; interrupted requests are not retried automatically. Local tasks continue when this window closes and stop when the app exits normally.
工作空间暂未保存；已派发的任务继续执行。: The workspace could not be saved. The dispatched task will continue.
WorkBuddy Access Token 格式无效，请重新保存官方授权令牌。: Invalid WorkBuddy Access Token format. Save a valid official OAuth token.
WorkBuddy 响应过大，无法确认接收结果，未自动重发。: The WorkBuddy response was too large to confirm receipt. The task was not resent.
发送时创建项目目录，并在其中开启新对话。: Sending creates the project folder and starts a chat in it.
暂时无法读取本机对话索引。: The local chat index could not be read.
无法创建或打开项目，请检查目录权限。: Could not open or create the project. Check directory permissions.
这个项目名称已存在，请使用其他名称。: A project with this name already exists.
请输入有效的项目名称，最多 64 个字符。: Enter a valid project name of up to 64 characters.
Codex 未返回本机对话列表。: Codex did not return its local chat list.
读取 Codex 对话超时，请重试。: Loading Codex chats timed out. Try again.
所选对话与项目不匹配，请重新选择。: The selected chat does not belong to this project. Choose it again.
这个对话已有派发任务，请等它结束后再发送。: There is already a dispatched task for this chat. Wait for it to finish.
工具返回的会话与所选对话不一致，请检查原生会话。: The tool returned a different chat ID. Check the chat in the tool.
任务已派发，可在作业列表查看进度: Task dispatched. Progress is available in Jobs.
